name: dev-agents
description: Ten subagents with the model tier bound per role, so read-only exploration runs on haiku and only real design judgement runs on opus. Includes a delegation strategy skill that says which agent to pick and how to brief it, plus three reminder hooks: one when the main thread has been grinding alone too long, and a pair that asks for a task plan before a subagent is dispatched so a long run plus context compaction cannot lose your remaining steps. Does NOT replace /model opusplan for getting code implementation onto a cheaper tier; see the skill.
